requirements.text: A valid shipment creation request sent with POST /api/v1/shipments returns HTTP 201 with code SHIPMENT_CREATED.
A valid package addition request sent with POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED.
A valid pickup scheduling request sent with POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/pickup returns HTTP 202 with code PICKUP_SCHEDULED.
A valid pickup cancellation request sent with DELETE /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/pickup returns HTTP 200 with code PICKUP_CANCELLED.
A valid label generation request sent with POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/label returns HTTP 201 with code LABEL_CREATED.
A valid manifest close request sent with POST /api/v1/manifests/{manifest_id}/close returns HTTP 200 with code MANIFEST_CLOSED.

POST /api/v1/shipments accepts package_count as an integer from 1 through 200 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code SHIPMENT_CREATED at either boundary; package_count values 0 and 201 return HTTP 422 with code PACKAGE_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE.

POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages accepts weight_grams as an integer from 1 through 30000 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED at either boundary; weight_grams values 0 and 30001 return HTTP 422 with code WEIGHT_GRAMS_OUT_OF_RANGE.

POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages accepts length_cm as an integer from 1 through 120 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED at either boundary; length_cm values 0 and 121 return HTTP 422 with code LENGTH_CM_OUT_OF_RANGE.

POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages accepts width_cm as an integer from 1 through 80 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED at either boundary; width_cm values 0 and 81 return HTTP 422 with code WIDTH_CM_OUT_OF_RANGE.

POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages accepts height_cm as an integer from 1 through 80 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED at either boundary; height_cm values 0 and 81 return HTTP 422 with code HEIGHT_CM_OUT_OF_RANGE.

POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages accepts declared_value_cents as an integer from 1 through 100000 inclusive and returns HTTP 201 with code PACKAGE_ADDED at either boundary; declared_value_cents values 0 and 100001 return HTTP 422 with code DECLARED_VALUE_CENTS_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role calling POST /api/v1/shipments is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The auditor role calling POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/packages is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The picker role calling POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/pickup is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The viewer role calling DELETE /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/pickup is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The guest role calling POST /api/v1/shipments/{shipment_id}/label is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
The picker role calling POST /api/v1/manifests/{manifest_id}/close is denied with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
